Name: Spreading The Glories Incorporated
Description: A media and entertainment company based in the Draconis Combine, specializing in low-quality holovids, books and art designed for the Kuritan masses. While nominally independent, its products and contents are closely monitorized by the Coordinator and the ISF through the Voice of the Dragon, the propaganda division of its secret police.
